prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Sugar Land, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1463; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the sideswipe collision you reported in Sugar Land, Texas. Do you understand that this conversation is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please state the location where the collision happened.

A: It was on the access road near the shopping center, in the right lane, heading toward the highway.

Q: Tell me what you were doing right before the impact.

A: I was changing lanes to move into the left lane because I needed to get over for my exit. I checked my mirror, I saw a gap, and I started to move over.

Q: Did you use your turn signal?

A: I believe I did. I flicked it on before I started drifting over.

Q: What happened next?

A: The other vehicle was in my blind spot, and I didn't see it. We made contact along the passenger side of my car. There was a loud scrape and I pulled over right after.

Q: Did you notice any injuries at the scene?

A: Not right away. I was shaken up. Later that evening my neck got stiff and my lower back started aching.

Q: Have you seen a medical provider since the collision?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care the next morning. They diagnosed a neck and back strain and gave me muscle relaxers and a referral for physical therapy.

Q: Are you currently experiencing any ongoing pain or limitations?

A: Yes. Turning my head to the right hurts, and sitting for long periods makes my back worse. I have had to adjust how I drive and how I work.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I'm willing to provide my medical records.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
